lines.rom: om jaya narasimha hare prabhu jaya narasimha hare stambha phara prabhu prakate stambha phara prabhu prakate jana ka tapa hare
tuma ho dina dayala bhaktana hitakari prabhu bhaktana hitakari adbhuta rupa banakara adbhuta rupa banakara prakate bhaya hari
sabake hrdaya vidarana dasyu jiyo mari prabhu dasyu jiyo mari dasa jana apanayo dasa jana apanayo jana para krpa kari
brahma karata arati mala pahinave prabhu mala pahinave sivaji jaya jaya kahakara puspana barasave
